summary: Iter29 regression after cheap-architecture pivot (Firebase FCM / Twilio SMS / Google Maps Live Tracking stripped) and modular refactor of FoodPage (1319->515 lines + 7 extracted components) and AuctionsPage (1817->1388 lines + BuyCreditsModal + ReferralPanel + atoms.js). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (100%). Removed /api/fcm/* and /api/sms/* correctly return 404. /api/push/vapid-public-key still works. New /api/payments/create-payment-intent is correctly hardened: 401 unauth, 200+client_secret on valid JWT+amount=10, 422 on amount>500 (pydantic le=500), 400 on 0<amount<1 (custom MIN check), 422 on amount=0 (pydantic gt=0). Frontend: admin login works, AuctionsPage renders fully with LIVE auctions list, daily reward, ReferralPanel loads referral_code 'BB-TO4DRM' from /api/auctions/user/referral, leaderboard renders. FoodPage renders (testids food-page, food-cart-icon, group-tracker-banner present) — for admin user the OrderTrackingView was active because a Group Order from Luigi's Pizzeria was in flight (expected behavior, tracker progress bar visible, 'Lieferung bestätigen' button rendered). Two React warnings on auctions page: (1) duplicate children keys and (2) a button-nested-inside-button hydration error in AuctionsPage Suspense tree.

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration error: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. React logs the AuctionsPage stack trace. Causes client/server DOM mismatch and invalid HTML; likely in the auction card / action row after the BuyCreditsModal / ReferralPanel extraction.
Multiple 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings — duplicate React keys in a list render (most likely the auction list, recent winners ticker, or category chips).
An empty string ('') passed to . Browser re-downloads the page as the src. Guard with `src={url || undefined}` or conditional render.

backend: POST /api/auth/login — admin + kunde both 200, cookie session
GET /api/auth/ws-token — 300s JWT with type=access (used to drive payment-intent tests)
frontend: Login form (data-testid=login-email-input / login-password-input) works with admin@bidblitz.com

AuctionsPage renders: daily reward, ReferralPanel with loaded referral_code (BB-TO4DRM), recent winners ticker, category chips, LIVE-AUKTIONEN list with price/bids/timer — network call /api/auctions/user/referral succeeded

FoodPage renders (data-testid food-page + group-tracker-banner + food-cart-icon) — for admin user an in-flight Group Order from Luigi's Pizzeria triggers OrderTrackingView; progress bar, ETA 00:47 and delivery confirmation button all render

action_items: Fix button-nested-in-button hydration error in AuctionsPage (inspect the auction card action area / BuyCreditsModal trigger — likely an <motion.button> rendered inside another <button> after the extraction).
Deduplicate React keys in AuctionsPage list renders (auctions list / categories / winners).
Guard tags so src is never an empty string; use conditional render or src={url || undefined}.
Optional regression coverage: add a backend test that simulates a full Food checkout (already covered elsewhere) to ensure the orchestrator/extracted components keep posting to the same endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/payments/create-payment-intent hardening is correct: JWT via core.security.get_current_user (cookie OR Bearer), rate limit 10/min, server-defined MIN/MAX (1€..500€), metadata carries user_id for the webhook. Good separation.
apple_google_pay.webhook/stripe-payment is idempotent (checks db.transactions.find_one({reference: pi_id})) and fails-closed when STRIPE_PI_WEBHOOK_SECRET missing — safe default.
server.py no longer mounts push_router/sms_router (FCM/SMS intentionally 404). web_push_router (VAPID) remains mounted — confirmed via /api/push/vapid-public-key 200.
FoodPage.jsx is now a thin orchestrator importing the 7 new modules from /components/food/*. Imports resolve and page renders, so the refactor did not break the route.

AuctionsPage.jsx still has a DOM invariant violation (button inside button) and duplicate-key warnings; not introduced by this test run but visible in console logs after the extraction. Treat as follow-up in the same refactor.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_regression.py (new — pytest class-based, 15 tests covering auth + removed FCM/SMS + kept VAPID + food/auctions list + referral + payment-intent hardening)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core routes render; two React DOM warnings on auctions)

test_credentials: admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! and kunde@bidblitz.com / Kunde2026! (cookie session via /api/auth/login; Bearer JWT via /api/auth/ws-token)
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Admin account already has an active Group Order from Luigi's Pizzeria which drove the OrderTrackingView rendering path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_regression.py — reuse it. Login on this deployment is cookie-based; for Bearer-token tests, call GET /api/auth/ws-token after login to mint a 300s access-type JWT that get_current_user accepts. Correct referral endpoint is /api/auctions/user/referral (NOT /api/auctions/referral — that 404s via the /{auction_id} catch-all). The main frontend bugs left are the hydration error (button-in-button) and duplicate-key warnings on AuctionsPage.
rca of the issue: N/A — regression scope clean. The only functional concerns are React-level DOM invariant violations on AuctionsPage (invalid nested <button>, duplicate keys, empty img src). Likely root cause: after extracting BuyCreditsModal/ReferralPanel, a trigger using <motion.button>/<button> got wrapped inside an outer <button> or <a role=button>. Fix by swapping the outer container to a <div role='button'> or making the inner trigger a <span>.
